name: ESA Sky API
tagline: Multi-mission ESA sky survey imagery and catalog overlays via public web services
description: ESASky is ESA's multi-wavelength sky portal providing access to observations, catalogs, and images from ESA space science missions. Developers can query sky positions, retrieve survey imagery (HiPS), load source catalogs, and overlay multi-mission data through documented web services and TAP endpoints rather than a single closed commercial API.

auth.details: Public anonymous access; no API key or OAuth required for standard TAP and imagery endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public free access; no published paid plans or numeric free-tier caps found

use_cases: query multi-mission observations near a sky coordinate
list available ESA survey datasets for a target
fetch catalog sources for a field of view
retrieve HiPS/image survey coverage for a region
build multi-wavelength sky overlays for research tools
